items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I think the bass player's name was John Brown.

ctx.x: see, it was about '59. Yeah, around that time, just before Stuff Smith died. And Stuff Smith, there was a giant. And I used to play with him quite a bit in Chicago. He used to come to Chicago to play the hotels, and I would just haunt him, and he had a guitarist by the name of Bernard Addison at this time. And Bernard -- I always admired Bernard as a great musician. He was a former alumni of let's see, Fletch Henderson.

And he'd played with the Mills Brothers before that, but he was just a good -- academically he was a good guitarist, and that I admired. But he kind of was a little skittish around me. He didn't want me to play around Stuff, but I just loved them so because Jonnie was in the band and let's see, Cozy Coley, and I think the bass player's name was John Brown. But had a very good group. And I would go there all the time because I just liked to play with Stuff and we would jam after -- in the dressing room. And --
